source_note: Manually transcribed from js/*-engine.js for the Flutter mobile app's on-device rule engine (apps/mobile/lib/domain/rules/, apps/mobile/lib/domain/services/*). NOT read by the web app - js/*.js stays the accuracy reference and is never modified as part of this file's maintenance. If js/ekadashi-engine.js, js/parana-engine.js, js/masa-engine.js, or js/event-matcher.js change, this file must be updated by hand to match. Verified against apps/mobile/test/fixtures/engine_parity.json (generated by scripts/generate-mobile-fixtures.mjs from the untouched web engine).

masa._comment: Mirrors js/masa-engine.js classifyMasaInterval (sankranti count inside one amavasya-to-amavasya interval). PanchangaCalculator._masaForDate already implements this same threshold directly; this table exists so the rule is expressed as data once, and to unit-test that Dart's hardcoded thresholds agree with it (see MasaRuleValidator).

parana._comment: Mirrors js/parana-engine.js computeParana (lines 67-134): one shared formula gated by which bucket fast_day_type falls into. See apps/mobile/lib/domain/services/parana_engine.dart for the ported formula itself - these are its configuration inputs, not the formula.
